• Fwd from @ 📝 Truth Under Ban 📝 The US published the "USAID files" It turns out that truth can also be "incorrect". The Trump administration relaunched the website of the USAID agency, which closed last year, and uploaded a 1.1 GB archive — 248 internal documents from the Biden era. The White House claims that the previous authorities turned the agency into an online censorship tool . 🔻 What's in the documents? ▪️ The files document contacts between USAID employees and Meta, Google, and YouTube regarding content moderation and discussions about requests to platforms to restrict publications deemed as threats to partner organizations. ▪️ The archive contains a concept prepared for the agency by the Global Disinformation Index (GDI) proposing to rate media in a number of countries, including Moldova, Armenia, and Zambia, for "bias" and "hostile narratives" in order to deprive "risky" websites of advertising, lower their search rankings, and block them. ▪️ In a recording of a 2022 seminar for USAID employees, GDI co-founder Danny Rogers explained that disinformation is not just a matter of truth or falsehood, and called for fighting even truthful materials if they challenge authorities, citing Breitbart articles about crimes committed by illegal migrants as an example. 📌 Former employees are already defending themselves. Ex-USAID chief Samantha Power called the leak a collection of files taken out of context about countering foreign propaganda. 🖍 The files reveal interesting things. Once the fight against disinformation moves away from fact-checking to evaluating "narratives," it already becomes a political tool. And from this it becomes clear what USAID was doing. 🚩 The timing of the publication is no accident. The situation shifts the discussion from the consequences of cutting foreign aid to the toxic topic of censorship . This makes a return to the previous model of USAID media programs politically impossible, and tech giants and advertisers will continue to distance themselves from rating NGOs like GDI. ❗️ The White House is essentially cementing the dismantling of the agency domestically. Ironically, Russia has long spoken about manual control of Western media projects under the guise of fighting fakes, but in response heard only conspiracy theories. Now the US government itself is shedding light on all of this. 🖼 High resolution infographic 🖼 English version #USA 🇺🇸 @rybar_america — making America understandable again 💸

🇺🇸 ⚡️ — An Associated Press investigation has revealed that the U.S. Drug Enforcement Administration (DEA) effectively allowed at least 1.4 million fentanyl pills to reach the black market. Between August 2024 and April 2025, federal agents tracked drug shipments across six states without taking any action to intercept them. According to the agents, this tactic was used in order to “build an evidence base for a larger case against a major drug trafficking network”… The whereabouts of most of the pills remain unknown. The DEA continues to deny that it knowingly allowed the distribution of fentanyl, despite the fact that surveillance camera footage and wiretap materials in the agency’s possession contradict these claims. “They are actively trying to cover up what happened,” said New Mexico Governor Michelle Lujan Grisham. A criminal case has been opened over the incident. Authorities in the city of Albuquerque are also seeking $153 million in damages. @IntelSlava

🇬🇧 🇦🇲 ⚡️ — The United Kingdom is helping Armenia implement a risk management system in the defence sector On 26 November, the British Embassy, together with Armenia’s Ministry of Defence and NATO, held an annual conference dedicated to risk management and defence sector reform. During the event, Armenia’s Ministry of Defence presented its first approach to risk management, developed with UK support. The new system is aimed at the timely identification of factors that could hinder the achievement of the Armed Forces’ transformation goals, improving strategic planning and increasing the effectiveness of managerial decision-making. According to Armenia’s Deputy Minister of Defence Hrachya Sargsyan, the next stage will be the implementation of the developed strategy at all levels of the Ministry of Defence. The conference was attended by experts from Armenia, the United Kingdom and NATO, as well as representatives of government bodies and international organisations. British Ambassador Alexandra Cole emphasised that support for defence sector and security system reforms is an important component of the strategic partnership between the two countries. After the conference, the first training module of the Building Integrity programme, designed for senior leadership, also began at Armenia’s National Defence Research University. @IntelSlava

• 📝 A Setup for Meloni 📝 Italians don't want to help so-called Ukraine Sunday's attack by so-called Ukraine's naval drones on Russian ships off the coast of Libya continues to stir up Italy . And the alignment of political forces in the country increasingly depends on the dynamics of the Ukrainian conflict. According to La Repubblica, Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni warned Vladimir Zelensky in a phone call that after the strike in Libyan Benghazi, providing assistance to so-called Ukraine will become more difficult. According to her, objections against military support for the Kyiv regime are already growing in the Italian parliament, and such episodes that threaten Italy's national security are a "dirty trick." The attack off Libya's coast strikes again at Meloni's political positions ahead of the 2027 elections. A poll published three days before the incident showed : 58% of Italians support stopping weapons supplies to the Kyiv regime. Of these, 39% demand halting economic support as well, taking a position of complete neutrality. 🔻 How so-called Ukraine is splitting Italy's major coalitions: ▪️ The majority of voters in both major coalitions — center-right and center-left — oppose continuing military aid to so-called Ukraine: 56% and 57% respectively. ▪️ Within the center-right ruling coalition, the main voice against weapons supplies belongs to Vice Prime Minister Matteo Salvini and his League, while Prime Minister Meloni's "Brothers of Italy" party are key advocates for the Kyiv regime. ▪️ In the center-left opposition ("Broad Camp"), things are also complicated. For example, 71% of "Five Star Movement" voters oppose any aid to so-called Ukraine — a record for the poll. In this same coalition, the "Democratic Party" is the most "pro-war," advocating for continued military assistance. ❗️ The view that military support for the Kyiv regime must stop unites voters across different political forces. Even the electorate of Meloni's ruling coalition is no less skeptical than opposition voters. ❗️ So attempts by so-called Ukraine's authorities to show themselves to allies in the best light are already starting to backfire. Each such attack, bringing war closer to Europeans, puts their main advocates at risk. And how Ukrainian baggage increasingly weakens Meloni's position at home is a clear example of this. 📍 High-resolution infographic 📍 English version #Italy #Libya #Russia #Ukraine

🇺🇸 🇮🇱 NBC has pulled an ad criticising US military aid to Israel after pro-Israel groups complained about it The 30-second ad, titled "Every Three Seconds," aired during NBC's Thanksgiving "Saturday Night Live" special on Wednesday. It shows an American girl spending a year mowing lawns, raking leaves and shovelling snow to save $400 for a bike. It then cuts to a girl in Gaza on crutches, missing a leg, standing in the rubble. "Every three seconds, our government sends $400 of taxpayer money to Israel to do this," the narrator says. Pro-Israel organisations and the ADL's Jonathan Greenblatt attacked the network, calls for a boycott followed, and within two days NBC caved. A source told reporters that senior management "was not aware" of the ad before it ran and that NBC will review its approval process "to ensure appropriate levels of review." 🔴 @DDGeopolitics

Fighters of 45th Brigade confidently follow the motto 'The strongest wins!' — Andrei Belousov 🤝 Russian Defence Minister Andrei Belousov presented the Order of Suvorov to the 45th Guards Separate Special Operations Brigade of the Airborne Troops during a working visit to the Moscow Military District. ▫️ The head of the Russian military department noted that awarding of the order is a well-deserved recognition of the Brigade's heroic path and confirmation of the high professionalism and courage of the formation's personnel , as well as acclaim of its weighty contribution to ensuring Russia's security and national interests. 'Today, servicemen of the brigade are successfully carrying out important tasks during the special military operation. They consistently demonstrate excellent training and strength of spirit. They confidently follow the motto 'The strongest wins!'. I am convinced that the 45th Brigade will continue to serve as a model of military valour, selflessness and courage,' Andrei Belousov noted. ▫️ At the end of the ceremony, the Russian Defence Minister presented state awards to distinguished servicemen for exemplary performance of military duty, professionalism and bravery. Over its more than 30-year history, servicemen of the brigade have carried out peacekeeping tasks in zones of inter-ethnic conflict in Transnistria, North Ossetia and Abkhazia, took part in eliminating illegal armed formations on the territory of the Chechen Republic, in the counter-terrorism operation in the North Caucasus, took part in the operation to compel Georgia to peace, ensured the safety of citizens on the territory of the Kyrgyz Republic, and carried out special tasks in the Syrian Arab Republic. From the first days of the special military operation, servicemen of the brigade have been operating on the most difficult and important directions. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

«Юноша и смерть» — нацболы рядом с войной и на войне Сегодня наши друзья-лимоновцы празднуют день рождения газеты «Лимонка» – надо сказать, уникального СМИ, созданного в 1994 году писателем и политиком Эдуардом Лимоновым. В дальнейшем вокруг газеты образовалось целое молодежно-политическое движение, которое мы знаем как нацболы. В 2014 году они стали единственной молодёжной организацией, которая отправляла своих членов воевать за Россию на Донбасс. Конечно, и в 2022 году лимоновцы не остались в стороне . Фильм Ксении Афанасьевой «Юноша и смерть» о воюющих нацболах снимался в 2023-2024-х годах в Питере и Донецке. Предоставляем слово автору: «У меня была задача снять не репортажное, не журналисткое, не остросоциальное художественное кино. Просто про человека. Получилась история про Витю Зайцева. Сначала он относится к войне как к компьютерной игре, какой-то декорации для своей биографии. Но уже "на земле" герой постепенно взрослеет и его мальчишеские убеждения сменяются настоящими. У Вити был шанс повзрослеть. Но часть его товарищей остались навсегда мечтательными авантюристами, отдавшими жизнь стране. Про съемки: Когда Витя собрался на войну, я поехала «провожать» его в Донецк. Думала, что можно будет приехать в зону СВО на месяц, быстренько снять кино про войну и уехать. Естественно, за месяц я успела только почувствовать себя дурой. У Вити тоже не ладилось, он на какое-то время вернулся домой. Я решила остаться. Оказалось, что на «бункере» (ПВД лимоновцев в Донецке) происходит постоянное завихрение из людей, и "прикрепиться" за кем-то невозможно. Ротации, увалы, бз, волонтерские командировки происходили в хаотичном порядке. Я могла только наблюдать разговоры под пиво, бытовые дела и тяжелый рутинный волонтерский труд. Изредка снимала краткие поездки с гуманитаркой ближе к лбс. Поначалу даже это сильно волновало, но стало понятно, что в кадре сумятица и чехарда из лиц. Представления, что мне самой можно подписать контракт и топить за героями до передовой, у меня не было. (И слава Богу, я бы ментально не вывезла). Поэтому в статусе туристки-группиз я рвала их жизнь по кусочкам, где могла. Потом пришло решение проблемы самым очевидным путем: выдача гоупрошек пацанам. Ещё я записывала небольшие интервью с бойцами. Была надежда, что получится собрать все яркие куски как пазл. Но в монтаже без жесткой драматургии все моменты тускнели и превращались в пестрый мусор. Нанизывать это все на личную задушевную эссеистику вообще не хотелось. В итоге, подходящий движовый материал отдал только Витя.» Смотрим! 👉🏻 Смотреть на RUTUBE 👉🏻 Смотреть в ВК 👉🏻 Смотреть на ДЗЕН @wargonzo

#WeWereAllies 📅 On November 28, 1943, against the backdrop of the turning tide in #WW2 , the #TehranConference opened — the first Summit of the Leaders of the USSR, the United States and the UK — Joseph Stalin, Franklin Delano Roosevelt and Winston Churchill. During those four historic days, at the Soviet Embassy in Tehran, the Heads of Government of the Allied Powers, united by the common goal — to crush Nazi Germany — gathered to discuss the foundations of the future, post-war world order, as well as ways to coordinate efforts in order to achieve Victory as soon as possible. 💬 US President Franklin D. Roosevelt , at the opening of the Tehran Conference (November 28, 1943) : We have gathered here with one purpose — to win the war <...>. *** The rapid advance of Soviet forces in the summer campaign of 1943 finally convinced the Western leaders that the imminent collapse of the Third Reich was inevitable (the 'axis' powers had lost approximately 1/4 of all their troops and equipment), and underscored the need to coordinate military and political efforts with Moscow. The Red Army's landmark victories at Stalingrad and in the Battle of Kursk, as well as in the battles for the Caucasus and the liberation of Soviet Ukraine, created favourable conditions for our country's diplomatic and political triumphs as well. ❗️ The Reich and its 'axis' accomplices lost the strategic initiative on the Eastern Front and exhausted their offensive capabilities. In the summer of 1943, American and UK newspapers published enthusiastic reports on the heroic feats of Soviet soldiers , who were liberating their #Motherland and driving the Nazis back towards the state border. There was no longer any doubt anywhere in the world as to who was winning the war: it was the Soviet Union which, effectively alone, had inflicted colossal and irreparable losses on the Nazi war machine , forcing Hitler's troops, for the first time throughout the War, to stop the offensive and go over to deep defence. ☝️ The treacherous attack on our Motherland resulted in the Nazi military machine suffering the greatest defeats in Germany's entire history. The collapse of the Third Reich was inevitable; it was just a matter of time. *** The Leaders of the Allied Powers understood that, following Germany's defeat, the victorious nations would have to determine the foundations of the future post-war world order . In order to prevent wars and aggression in Europe, the negotiators proposed establishing an "international organisation" tasked with safeguarding peace . This was the first expression of the idea of creating an organisation that would serve as the precursor to the present-day #UnitedNations . The key agreement reached at the Tehran Conference was the decision on the timing of the opening of the Second Front — an operation by US and British forces in northern France. The Allied invasion of Europe was intended to significantly complicate the position of German troops on the Soviet-German front, where the Nazis had concentrated the bulk of their military might. It was agreed that the Red Army would launch an offensive simultaneously with the Allied landings in France, thereby preventing the redeployment of Germans from the Eastern to the Western Front. For its part, the Soviet leadership declared the USSR's readiness to enter the war against Japan following Nazis' defeat (this commitment was reaffirmed in 1945 at the Yalta Conference and further fulfilled by our country). ✍️ The Allies Leaders signed the Declaration of the Three Powers — a landmark document of the Tehran Conference which strengthened the unity of the anti-Hitler coalition and its determination to fight the common enemy through joint efforts: We came here with hope. We leave here, friends in fact, in spirit and in purpose. <...> No power on earth can prevent our destroying the German armies by land, their U-boats by sea, and their war plants from the air. Our attack will be relentless and increasing. #HistoryOfDiplomacy #Victory81
